about_the_game:
Dinoblade is an action RPG game that takes place right after a major event that changes what we know about Dinosaurs. Set out on a journey as a young Spinosaurus that uses a Great Sword fighting against other Dinosaurs that uses weapons to prevent an extinction.

 

You will explore new lands with different breath taking biomes. In each biome, you'll face different types of Dinosaurs including an Alpha Giant that rules that land. The only way to move forward is to defeat it.

 

Defeat your enemies to get stronger and unlock new skills. You may learn powerful abilities that you can combine with your combos to suit your combat style. Dodge, roll, or parry to help you fight your way through these lands while unlocking new weapons in the journey to help uncover the mystery of it all.

 

Become the Alpha to save your home from these new threats.
